subject: german
title: Saying Your Name
welcome_lead: Ich heisse — telling people your name.
meta_desc: KS3 German: name, age and basic intro.

concepts.def: My name is (lit. I am called).

walkthroughs.body_html: Ich heisse + your name. 'Ich heisse Sam'. Ask: Wie heisst du? = 'What's your name?' (informal).
Wie geht es dir? = How are you? Reply Mir geht's gut (I'm good). Then ask Und dir? (And you?).
When meeting someone new: Freut mich = pleased to meet you. Shake hands — Germans usually shake hands when meeting.
